baseline.rule: During active P1, top-level breadth remains VOL-000..VOL-420. ADRs may be proposed or approved for future plan evolution but may not be applied.

exception_requirements: prove the requirement cannot be represented cleanly inside existing VOL-000..VOL-420 domains
analyze at least two existing candidate volumes and explain why each is insufficient
consider at least one non-expansion alternative
bind architecture-owner and independent-verifier approvals to exact commit and evidence
preserve P1 scope freeze until a future plan formally applies the ADR
